dct_description_sm: Street map of Passaic includes street car lines and a directory of fire alarms and their street locations. A paragraph called Passaic in a Nutshell lists various statistics, facts and municipal services for the community. Includes advertisement for Rowland and Shafto, Inc., Real Estate and Insurance.
